checks.title: Validate command priority during ambient backlog
checks.instructions: Generate sustained presentation speech while speculative/background work is active, then explicitly trigger and say a context-dependent command such as “Jarvis, affiche-moi ça” about the most recent topic.
checks.expected: Addressed command starts promptly without waiting for ambient backlog, resolves recent referent, reuses prepared material when available, and ambient analysis resumes without duplicate request.
